stories.headline: Bridgeport resident wins $30,000 lottery ticket sold at Trumbull Food Mart
stories.summary: A Bridgeport resident is $30,000 richer after buying a winning Connecticut Lottery “DIAMOND BINGO” ticket at Trumbull Food Mart LLC on Monday, Patch reported Tuesday. The CT Lottery confirmed the prize as a public record but no longer publishes winners’ full names without written consent, a privacy change that took effect Oct. 1, 2025. The win is a light local bright spot for Trumbull shoppers this week.

stories.headline: Trump plans rare tarmac welcome for Xi as three-day Washington state visit begins
stories.summary: President Trump is expected to greet Chinese President Xi Jinping on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews rather than waiting at the White House — a rare planeside welcome to open Xi’s first U.S. state visit in more than a decade. Melania Trump said her husband wanted to show “the most respect,” while Sen. Roger Wicker criticized a “lavish welcome” amid tensions over trade, AI, Iran, and Taiwan. A White House state dinner Thursday is set to include tech leaders such as Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and SpaceX’s Elon Musk.

stories.headline: LEGO reveals first-ever PlayStation set — 1,911 pieces with functional buttons
stories.summary: The LEGO Group unveiled set 72306, a near 1:1 brick replica of the original grey PlayStation console and first controller, with functional Open and Power buttons and a plug-in controller. Hidden buildable dioramas nod to Gran Turismo and Ape Escape. Priced at $179.99, the 1,911-piece 18+ set opens for LEGO Insiders early access Oct. 1 and for everyone Oct. 4 after a State of Play reveal.

stories.headline: Apple Watch Ultra 4 ships with Health Sensing System, readiness score, longer battery
stories.summary: Apple’s Watch Ultra 4 pairs the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip for denser all-day heart-rate and HRV readings plus a 0–10 readiness score for training days. Outdoor workout tracking stretches up to 45 hours in Max Extended Workout mode, with everyday battery life rated up to 50 hours. Natural and black titanium models started at $799 with store availability beginning Sept. 18.

stories.headline: Matt Walsh jokes he’ll take WNBA commissioner job — at a 50% pay cut
stories.summary: After WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said she will retire at year’s end, Matt Walsh told Benny Johnson he would “accept the position” despite barely watching the sport. Walsh quipped he would take 50% less pay than the outgoing commissioner to “even the score.” The tongue-in-cheek bid lands amid broader culture fights over player safety online and transgender eligibility debates around the league.

stories.headline: Elon Musk keeps Tesla–SpaceX merger talk alive after All-In Summit remarks
stories.summary: At the All-In Summit, Elon Musk declined to shut down questions about combining Tesla and SpaceX, pointing to “so much close collaboration” across the companies. SpaceX COO Gwynne Shotwell separately said staff and projects are integrating faster than expected, including work tied to Terafab chip manufacturing in Texas. No merger agreement, timetable, or deal structure has been announced — only renewed speculation after SpaceX’s June public listing.

stories.headline: Erika Kirk sends anniversary video message to Truth & Liberty Conference
stories.summary: On the one-year anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s killing, Erika Kirk delivered a prerecorded address of gratitude and resolve to the free Truth & Liberty Conference in Woodland Park, Colo. Organizers said the message urged attendees to keep standing for faith and freedom as Charlie did. The Sept. 10–12 gathering tightened security as Utah courts separately ordered accused shooter Tyler Robinson to stand trial.

stories.headline: Penguins fall 7–4 to Red Wings as Ruck twins and Robertson debut highlights
stories.summary: Pittsburgh dropped its second preseason game 7–4 to Detroit, but 2026 draft picks Liam and Markus Ruck made strong first impressions in black and gold. Liam posted two assists and Markus set up Rutger McGroarty, while Nick Robertson notched a highlight-reel shorthanded goal in his Pens debut. Coach Dan Muse praised the twins’ engagement and said more practice and games will help goalie Arturs Silovs settle in.

stories.headline: Jets promote Heflin and McClain, place Onyemata, McCrary-Ball, and Smith on IR
stories.summary: New York signed DL Jack Heflin and WR Malik McClain from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday after injuries mounted. DL David Onyemata (groin), LB Marcelino McCrary-Ball (ankle), and WR Arian Smith (knee) went on injured reserve; Smith’s injury came against Green Bay. The Jets also added DT Isaiahh Loudermilk and TE Cody Hardy to the practice squad as they prep for Detroit.

stories.headline: Insta360 Luna Ultra firmware adds 15× zoom, Stage Mode, and 4K vertical video
stories.summary: Insta360’s Sept. 21 Luna Ultra update pushes in-camera zoom to 15× (about 300mm equivalent) and pairs with a new Ultra Telephoto Lens for up to ~450mm reach. Stage Mode tunes tracking, exposure, and audio for concerts, while 4K30 vertical video targets social clips. A Zoom Bundle with carry bag and telephoto lens lists at $889.99 via the Insta360 app update path.

stories.headline: Karen Woodall: treat enmeshment after divorce as coercive control of a child’s mind
stories.summary: In a Sept. 18 essay, clinician Karen Woodall argues coercive control is more than a checklist of adult behaviors — it can shrink a child’s psychological freedom inside enmeshed or disorganized caregiving. She urges post-divorce assessors to test how a child’s rigid alignment or rejection developed, not merely accept stated wishes at face value. The piece ties into her forthcoming Routledge book The Journey of the Alienated Child and Family Separation Clinic training.

stories.headline: USA fall foliage 2026: Northeast rebound, early West color, drought pockets up north
stories.summary: ABC News/GMA’s Sept. 22 foliage outlook says the Northeast is primed for a stronger color season after two drought-dulled autumns, with many areas peaking in early October and coasts later. Western states such as Colorado and Utah are already showing color a bit early amid heat and dryness. Severe drought in Wisconsin’s North Woods and Michigan’s U.P. may mute vibrancy even as average peak maps still point to early October for the Upper Midwest.

stories.headline: Harley-Davidson repeats as 2026 Mission AFT SuperTwins manufacturer champion
stories.summary: Harley-Davidson sealed the 2026 Mission AFT SuperTwins manufacturer title after Springfield Mile, finishing with 331 points — 17 clear of Yamaha. Kody Kopp led Harley riders with three wins and a runner-up season finish on an XG750R, while Briar Bauman added six victories en route to third. James Rispoli capped the weekend by leading a Route 66 Ride to the Race from Shorewood, Ill., to the track.

stories.headline: Jeep launches “This Is Jeep Country” national campaign spanning the full lineup
stories.summary: Jeep’s Sept. 9 “This Is Jeep Country” campaign frames America as the brand’s first customer and ties 85 years of 4x4 heritage to freedom and grit. Spots and digital films show Wrangler, Gladiator, Grand Cherokee, Recon, and other models across deserts, forests, mountains, and coasts, plus owner UGC. Media buys stretch across NFL, streaming (Disney+, Paramount+, Max, Peacock), and Hispanic/AA digital extensions via agency Highdive.

stories.headline: Pantera headlining The Great Nola Trendkill festival in New Orleans this November
stories.summary: Housecore Horror, Housecore Records, and Live Nation set The Great Nola Trendkill for Nov. 20–21 at Lakefront Arena, headlined by Pantera’s first New Orleans show in 30 years and a celebration of The Great Southern Trendkill’s anniversary. DOWN will stage its Volume V release show the same weekend, with Black Label Society, Corrosion of Conformity, Power Trip, Crowbar, Eyehategod, and more. Philip Anselmo called returning home with the package “a dream come true.”
